_note: Games for which we only have a hand-kept sheet of ONE team. They never count as box scores (see stats.py, 'One-team box scores'): each listed player gets one row in his game log, stats the sheet does not give (minutes, turnovers, fouls, +/-) stay unknown instead of 0, and every average is taken over the games where the stat is known. Keys: id, matchday, home, away, recorded (the team on the sheet), date (date_approx if not certain), players with number, name, pts, fgm, fga, p3m, p3a, ftm, fta, oreb, dreb, ast, stl, blk. Attempts are only what the sheet proves (a '0 made, 0%' cell counts as no attempt). data/partial_games.json adds games of its own.

games.source: Hand-written sheet 'Stats Goulette G1' (Club Africain players only), typed 2026-11-10
games.note: Club Africain players only. The sheet adds up to the official 80 points. Chennoufi: 15 pts with 7 FT means 4 field goals, but the sheet's 62.5% would be 5/8 (17 pts), so FG is stored as 4/8. Abada: sheet says 52% FG, 7/13 is 53.8%. 'Hamdi' on the sheet is read as Hadidane (#9), 'Plagne' as Diagne (#21), 'Gammoun' as Gannouni (#6), 'Apeda' as Abada (#24).
